PATTERN: All creative assets belong in production-studio, not in app repos

CORRECT STRUCTURE:
  production-studio/
  ├── projects/
  │   ├── negotiation-trainer/
  │   │   ├── avatars/mentor/variant-01.png ... variant-04.png
  │   │   ├── demos/
  │   │   └── output/
  │   ├── whisnap/
  │   └── personal-youtube/
  ├── scripts/
  ├── skills/
  ├── remotion/
  └── .env

WHEN working on a product: open Claude Code in production-studio/, set project to projects/[product-name]/
APP REPOS (negotiation-trainer/, whisnap/, etc.) contain only code — no .studio/ folders, no avatar files
